sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Importation of Deep-Frozen Meat Carcasses and Pelagic Fish

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Hispanic/Colombian civil-law heritage with Anglo-American features in corporate, trust, and maritime legislation; unitary national system with no sub-state corporate tax distinction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States–Panama Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA, in force 31 October 2012; includes investor-state arbitration chapter)
Panama–United Kingdom Double Taxation Agreement (in force)
Panama–Netherlands Double Taxation Agreement (in force since 2011)
Panama–Singapore Double Taxation Agreement (in force since 2022)
Panama–Republic of Korea Double Taxation Agreement (in force)
Panama–Germany Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force since 1984)
Panama–France Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force since 1983)
Panama–Spain Agreement on Reciprocal Protection of Investments (in force)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (AML/CFT framework); Ley No. 70 de 30 de enero de 2019 (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales) implemented by Decreto Ejecutivo No. 129 de 6 de mayo de 2020; Decreto Ley No. 2 de 1 de febrero de 2011 (creates Unidad de Análisis Financiero – UAF); Ley No. 4 de 4 de abril de 2023 (Ley General de Sociedades, effective 26 July 2024) replacing Ley 32 de 1927; FATF Fourth-Round Mutual Evaluation standards; Panama removed from FATF grey list in October 2023.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of constitutional documents and Certificate of Good Standing (Paz y Salvo) of each legal-person shareholder/UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country Companies Registry or Registro Público de Panamá (for Panamanian corporate shareholders)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the competent authority in the document's country of origin (for Panama: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores). Non-Hague signatory jurisdictions: Panamanian Consular Legalization.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Panama General Corporation Law, Law 32 of 1927, as amended, Articles 1-14 (incorporation and capital) and Articles 54-61 (directors and officers); supplemented by Law 5 of 2015 and Executive Decree 195 of 2010.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Public Registry of Panama), Mercantile Section.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation) recorded as a Ficha in the Mercantile Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No paid-up capital is required at formation. The articles must authorize initial capital of at least USD 10,000, but shares may be issued without immediate payment; no escrow account is required under Panamanian law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporation of the corporation pursuant to the Articles of Incorporation filed with the Public Registry of Panama is hereby ratified; that the authorized capital is divided into 10,000 ordinary shares at a par value of one US dollar each, of which 100 shares are subscribed by the founding stockholders at this time; that the registered office shall be maintained at the address of the resident agent until changed by the Directors; and that the persons named as President, Treasurer and Corporate Secretary in the Articles are hereby appointed to their respective offices, each with authority to open bank accounts, execute agreements, and make all regulatory filings necessary to commence the frozen beef and seafood import operation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Ventanilla de Certificado de Nombre (online portal: www.registro.gob.pa)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three proposed corporate names through the Registry's online name-certificate module. Pay the clearance fee, obtain a 'Certificado de Búsqueda y Reserva de Nombre' valid for 30 days, and commit the selected name to the notarial draft.
required_dossiers: Notarized request form (Formulario de Certificado de Nombre)
Copy of applicant's passport or Panamanian cedula
Power of attorney if filing through a resident agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name is rejected or conflicts with an existing registration, the Registry's resolution will indicate the conflicting entry; the applicant may file a written reconsideration within 5 working days or select another of the retained reserved alternatives.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarial execution of the public deed of incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública de la República de Panamá (licensed notary in Panama City)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the approved name certificate and draft 'Escritura Pública de Constitución' to a Panamanian notary. The incorporators, or a designated representative under power of attorney, must appear before the notary, execute the deed, and ensure the deed contains the exclusive name, corporate purpose, capital structure, resident agent designation, and initial director appointments.
required_dossiers: Draft articles of incorporation and bylaws
Letter of acceptance from the registered resident agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The notary will issue a certificate of objection if the deed lacks mandatory statutory clauses; the deed must be amended and re-executed before the notarial validity period of 30 days expires.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the Sociedad Anónima in the Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Dirección General del Registro, Mercantile Section, via the Sede Electrónica
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the first-genera-copy (testimonio) of the executed public deed for inscription. Complete the 'Ficha de Registro' and pay the official arancel. After review, the Registry issues formal 'Inscripción de la Sociedad', evidencing legal existence. Obtain a certified copy for use in bank and tax filings.
required_dossiers: Testimony of the executed public deed
Proof of payment of the public registry fee
Certificate of registration issued by the notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a 'reparo' (deficiency notice), the resident agent has 10 working days to correct or clarify the deed by executing a notarial amendment; an additional filing fee may apply for the amended document.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration governance act and tax identification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; Municipalidad de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days of registry inscription, the Directors must hold the First Board Meeting to ratify the share subscription, designate the registered office, and confirm officers. The Corporate Secretary must record the minutes in the corporate minute book. Simultaneously, register the company for tax purposes to obtain the RUC/NIT via DGI's online portal, and obtain the municipal 'Aviso de Operación' for the wholesale commercial unit.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the registered deed
Minutes of the first board meeting
Registered agent and directors' letters of acceptance
Warehouse lease agreement for municipal registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DGI rejects the RUC application for missing documentation, a formal correction and re-submission may be made within 5 working days; municipal licensing objections are cured by updating the local premises evidence.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Salud (MINSA) - Dirección de Control de Alimentos; Autoridad de los Recursos Acuáticos de Panamá (ARAP) for fishery imports; Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) for environmental permitting.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Certificado de Aviso de Operación Sanitario (Sanitary Operating Permit) issued by MINSA, plus the corresponding Registro Sanitario de Alimentos for each imported frozen meat and seafood product line.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) - Dirección de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I (Registro Ambiental) for cold storage and wholesale warehouse operations; a full EIA is not required unless the installation exceeds the built-area thresholds set under Executive Decree No. 123 of 2009.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: All wastewater discharges must comply with Executive Decree No. 314 of 2008 (maximum permissible values for physicochemical and bacteriological parameters). Refrigerant emissions (VOCs/ammonia) must be minimized through a certified maintenance protocol, and hazardous waste such as refrigeration oils must be disposed through an authorized waste handler under municipal solid waste rules.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá, structural load inspection from the municipal technical engineering office, and workplace safety clearance from the Departamento de Salud y Seguridad Ocupacional del Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas de la República de Panamá; electronic portal: SICAR (https://dgi.mef.gob.pa / SICAR e-filing platform).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Panamanian Sociedad Anónima obtains its RUC/NIT by filing the public deed of incorporation with the Registro Público, through its resident agent, and submitting the electronic SICAR application to DGI. The DGI assigns a single RUC that serves for both income tax and ITBMS (VAT) registration. For foreign entities without a Panama corporate charter, the non-resident corporation must appoint a resident legal representative, file notarized and apostilled constitutional documents, register a Panamanian tax domicile, and submit the DGI Form for taxpayer registration through a tax attorney; the same RUC covers income tax, ITBMS, and customs obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation under Territorial_Scope (Panama-source income only; the Panamanian S.A. is not a pass-through entity and is subject to corporate income tax at 25% on net Panama-source income, plus dividend tax upon distribution).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists in Panama; a domestic S.A. is per se taxable and cannot elect pass-through treatment. Available statutory elections include the simplified small taxpayer regime for gross income not exceeding US$36,000, optional accelerated depreciation, large taxpayer periodic prepayment methods, and foreign-sales exclusion regimes where expressly codified. Hybrid mismatch or transparent entity elections are not permitted under Panamanian domestic law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios), Panama's value-added tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: US$0.00 — no de minimis threshold; any person engaged in taxable supplies within Panama must register for ITBMS. An optional simplified regime applies to small taxpayers with annual gross income up to US$36,000.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica) under DGI Resolution; authorized taxpayers must issue invoices in XML format through DGI-certified software, incorporate a digital fiscal stamp and QR code, transmit invoice data to the DGI's SICAR/Facturación Electrónica service within 24 hours, and obtain prior validation of credit/debit notes. The system does not operate as a real-time pre-clearance model but imposes contemporaneous electronic transmission and digital stamping requirements.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods qualify for 0% ITBMS when the goods are physically transported from Panama to a foreign destination and sold to a non-resident purchaser for use or consumption abroad. Services may be zero-rated when rendered to non-residents and effectively used outside Panama. The exporter must be registered with DGI, issue an electronic invoice marked 'exportación', maintain complete customs and shipping evidence, and substantiate receipt of payment from abroad. Input ITBMS attributable to zero-rated exports may be credited, and any residual credit is refundable upon application through SICAR.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración Única Aduanera de Exportación)
Bill of Lading / Airway Bill evidencing physical departure from Panama
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank SWIFT / transfer receipt evidencing payment from abroad)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI examines physical export exit, authenticity of foreign payment, and proper issuance of the export invoice. Failure to substantiate zero-rating leads to re-characterization as a taxable domestic supply, triggering 7% ITBMS, 25% corporate income tax, plus late-payment surcharges and interest. Fraudulent zero-rating claims or forged documentation expose taxpayers to fines ranging from 50% to 200% of the omitted tax, potential closure of operations, and criminal tax-fraud liability under Panama's Código Fiscal. Panama imposes no statutory FX repatriation deadline, but the taxpayer must maintain contemporaneous bank evidence of receipt from abroad; unexplained delay may intensify audit scrutiny and cast doubt on the export character of the transaction.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama does not have a traditional central bank. Monetary and banking supervision is exercised by the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP); the Banco Nacional de Panamá acts as fiscal agent of the State and provider of treasury services; the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF) is responsible for external credit and sovereign debt policy. The Panamanian Balboa is pegged at 1:1 to the US Dollar, and USD is fully legal tender.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama operates under full dollarization. There are no exchange controls, no currency conversion licensing, no capital account restrictions, and no current account licensing requirements for import payments or profit remittances. Inward wires in USD can be credited directly to domestic accounts without central bank registration. Profit distribution may trigger Panamanian territorial dividend tax obligations, but there is no currency-control hurdle to repatriating funds abroad.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Panama imposes no export proceeds surrender rules, no mandatory repatriation period, and no statutory conversion ratio for export receipts. Exporters and importers may freely maintain USD and foreign-currency accounts onshore or offshore. Panamanian customs and SBP AML rules apply only to documentary integrity, sanctions screening, and beneficial ownership disclosure; no foreign-exchange administration approval is required for import settlement.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Account; no statutory capital escrow required for Panama Sociedad Anónima; may hold optional LC collateral sub-account
Operational USD Account and Revolving Trade Finance LC Account
Operational USD Account and Import Settlement Account
Operational USD Account with Online Treasury Platform and LC Facility
Operational USD Account and Cold-Chain Commodity Import Clearing Account
Specialized Offshore-Oriented USD Account and Private Treasury Services

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability as a primary treasury node; acceptable only as an ancillary payment channel. Offshore digital EMIs are not licensed Panamanian banks and cannot issue Panamanian IBANs or provide insured demand-deposit accounting. A non-resident EMI must contract with an SBP-licensed local bank or obtain a special license under Panamanian banking law. For a frozen beef and seafood importer, principal payables and LC operations should remain on tier-1 bank rails; fintech EMIs are suitable only for low-value supplier expense cards or supplementary payment testing.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is strongly preferred and is routinely mandated at first onboarding for non-resident directors and beneficial owners. Panamanian AML rules under Law 23 of 2015 and SBP regulations require legalized corporate documents, a notarized board resolution, passport copies, UBO disclosure, and sanctions/PEP screening. Some banks accept remote biometric video-KYC for low-risk corporate clients after a prior in-country banking relationship, but for meat and seafood import trades involving documentary LCs, an in-person interview of at least one authorized signatory or director is usually required. The designated Resident Agent must be retained in Panama but does not replace beneficial-owner verification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity arising from bearer-share legacy, nominee directors, or indirect shareholding layers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current share register or Libro de Acciones; notarized sworn beneficial-ownership declaration under Law 23 of 2015; certification that no bearer shares remain outstanding or proof of immobilization/escrew at a licensed custodian; corporate chart; passport copies of all ultimate natural persons; commercial resume and prior audited financial statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, OFAC, UN, or EU advisories concerning suppliers, shipping vessels, or transactional counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Systematic OFAC/UN/EU sanctions screen for UBOs, directors, counterparties, vessels and ports; vessel registration and IMO number; marine insurance certificate; negative-media report; contractual warranty confirming no US blocked party; explanation of cargo country-of-origin; independent shipping-chain due diligence dossier.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade document mismatch or insufficient cold-chain evidence for frozen beef carcasses and pelagic fish
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid import license issued by Comisión Panamá? Use appropriate agencies: MICI, ARAP, COPANIT; veterinary health certificate from exporting country; temperature log throughout transit; cold-chain Bill of Lading; commercial invoice and packing list; HS tariff classification aligned with Panamanian Customs declaration; supplier contract; fumigation or phytosanitary certificate where relevant.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of funds for initial capital injection or shareholder loan financing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved capital contribution resolution; signed shareholder loan agreement; prior bank statements substantiating wealth; sworn source-of-funds statement; audited financial statements or management accounts; shareholder tax returns if available; contractual chain proving legitimate commercial origin; no cash deposits or third-party wire funding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Wild-caught seafood flagged for IUU fishing or CITES-protected species
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Catch certificate and legal origin documentation; vessel flag and IMO number; ARAP fishing authorization; recognized traceability records from harvest to export; species scientific name and HS coding; import permit; port inspection certificate; supplier registration with competent fisheries authority.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inject equity or shareholder loans through SWIFT MT103 wire denominated in USD from the overseas shareholder to tier-1 Panamanian receiving bank. Beneficiary: PA_CORP Sociedad Anónima; receiving bank BIC in 57A; beneficiary account in 59; remittance purpose code in 70: 'CAPITAL INJECTION / SHAREHOLDER LOAN / NOT SUBJECT TO CENTRAL BANK EXCHANGE APPROVAL'. Pre-notify the relationship manager with a capital contribution resolution, UBO declaration, and source-of-funds packet. No Panamanian central bank permit is needed; no FX conversion occurs because USD is legal tender. Avoid cash deposits, unrelated third-party remitters, or split transaction schemes that would trigger enhanced due diligence.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use two principal clearing rails: direct SWIFT MT103 wire for open-account or proforma-based settlements, and documentary Letters of Credit issued under UCP600 for revolving meat and seafood purchases. Revolving LC may be issued locally by Banco Banistmo, Banco General, Multibank, or Global Bank and confirmed by a supplier-country bank; settlement occurs by SWIFT MT103/MT202 after LC presentation. Before release of funds, banks may require a Panamanian customs declaration trace, import license reference, veterinary certificate, and transport temperature report. For USD-denominated payables, no FX-derived clearing inefficiency exists. Cheques and manual cash payments should be prohibited as treasury policy.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/EUR or USD/GBP forward contract executed through an SBP-licensed Panamanian commercial bank or international branch
Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) for Latin American emerging currencies via designated global-market desks of tier-1 banks
Plain-vanilla cross-currency swap with a highly rated international bank counterparty to hedge non-USD LC payables
FX swap for temporary conversion of USD trade balances into EUR/GBP where supplier invoices require non-USD settlement
Interest-rate or commodity hedging is not required for FX control purposes and may only be implemented under bank derivative eligibility and board-approved treasury policy

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporation Tax of Sociedad Anónima ('Tasa Anual' / 'Impuesto Anual a las Sociedades Anónimas')
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Impuestos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance, Republic of Panama; payment is effected through Banco Nacional de Panamá or authorized banks
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between 1 January and 31 July; reduced fee of USD 250 if settled by 31 March, standard fee of USD 300 if settled by 30 June, and increased fee of USD 400 for settlements made during July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid tax after 31 July triggers an additional USD 100 surcharge (aggregate USD 500); the DGI withholds the 'Paz y Salvo' tax clearance and the Registro Público will not certify the S.A. in good standing, blocking notarization of share transfers and registered corporate acts; Panama does not provide for automatic administrative strike-off, but persistent non-payment normally beyond three consecutive years leads to RUC cancellation, suspension of the entity's capacity to invoice imports, and administrative collection measures against the S.A.'s assets.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return ('Declaración de Renta') including financial-data annexes under the applicable general or large-taxpayer regime
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Impuestos (DGI) — Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC) administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due by 31 March following the close of the calendar fiscal year (31 December); companies using an authorized off-calendar fiscal year must file within three months after fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs a monthly surcharge of 2% of the tax due (capped at 10%) plus monthly interest of 1.5% on arrears; the DGI may issue an ex officio assessment for non-filers, impose fines up to USD 5,000 for repeated omission, and deny the 'Paz y Salvo'; continued default suspends the RUC and thereby the entity's capacity to operate as a formal importer of frozen beef and pelagic fish under ISIC 4632.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Confirmation to the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Impuestos (DGI) — Registro de Beneficiarios Finales, established under Law 23 of 2015, as amended by Law 254 of 2021 and Executive Decree 957 of 2022
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 30 days following the S.A.'s incorporation anniversary; any change in shareholding, transfer of shares, or change in the ultimate beneficial owner must additionally be declared within 30 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file the annual confirmation or to update the register within the 30-day period exposes the corporation to administrative fines (generally USD 500 to USD 5,000 per non-compliance, with escalation for recurring violations); the default is recorded in the entity's RUC file, suspending certificates of good standing and tax clearance and blocking notarial and registry processing of future share transfers.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Panama imposes no blanket statutory audit on non-regulated private S.A.s. An independent audit by a Contador Público Autorizado (licensed CPA) is mandatory for (i) a company designated as a 'Gran Contribuyente' (large taxpayer) by the DGI, (ii) any taxpayer whose annual gross revenue equals or exceeds USD 3,000,000 and that must therefore attach audited financial statements to the corporate income tax return, and (iii) entities subject to sectoral supervision (banking, insurance, and securities). Lenders financing the revolving letter-of-credit rails of a cold-chain meat and seafood importer will ordinarily covenant annually audited statements even when the statutory threshold is not met.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Full IFRS as adopted in Panama (NIIF); non-publicly accountable entities may use IFRS for SMEs. Statutory books must be maintained in Spanish (or accompanied by a notarized Spanish translation) and expressed in balboas/US dollars, being the currency in which the frozen beef and seafood import transactions are settled.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A. must maintain a complete register of ultimate natural-person beneficial owners (individuals with a direct or indirect interest of 10% or more or exercising control) and transmit any shareholding transfer to the DGI UBO registry within 30 days. Share transfers in frozen-beef and seafood import businesses are perfected for corporate-law purposes only upon endorsement in the share ledger ('Registro de Acciones') and on the share certificate; the annual anniversary-based confirmation must reconcile the ledger with the UBO data, and the registered agent ('Agente Residente') must attest the reconciliation to the DGI.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Registro de Acciones (shareholders' ledger / Register of Members)
Libro de Actas de la Asamblea de Accionistas (shareholders' minutes book)
Libro de Actas de la Junta Directiva (board of directors' minutes book)
Libro de Registro de Asistencia a las Asambleas (shareholders' attendance register)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 - 800 per annum (Panama City registered agent service, including registered office address and franchise-tax processing)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000 - 12,000 per annum for a licensed CPA audit of an operating wholesale frozen-meat and seafood importer; USD 1,500 - 3,000 for a non-operating holding S.A. review

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial source regime: foreign-source income is outside the Panamanian tax base, a decisive advantage for import merchants sourcing frozen beef and seafood from overseas suppliers. Preferential regimes: qualifying Multinational Headquarters (SEM, Ley 41 de 2007) entities benefit from a 5% dividend withholding rate on remittances; Panama Pacifico and free-zone entities enjoy full income and ITBMS exemptions on foreign-trade flows; accelerated depreciation of 20% straight-line is available for refrigerated warehousing and cold-chain handling equipment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 701 - Declaracion Jurada Anual del Impuesto Sobre la Renta para Personas Juridicas, filed mandatorily through the DGI E-Tax 2.0 portal (Direccion General de Ingresos, Ministry of Economy and Finance); the transfer-pricing annex is Form 708.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual on a calendar-year basis; alternative fiscal periods require prior DGI authorization and are rarely granted to ordinary S.A. entities.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before 31 March of the year following the fiscal year-end; no automatic extension for juridical persons; four quarterly advance payments (anticipos) are due in March, June, September and December against the final annual liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registro Unico de Contribuyente number of the Panamanian S.A.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A - form is filed by the resident entity; the non-resident shareholder holds no filing position on this return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calendar year covered by the return (e.g., 01/01/2025 to 12/31/2025).
All gross revenue from wholesale sales of deep-frozen meat carcasses and pelagic fish realized in Panamanian territory.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only Panamanian-source sales are declared; import-to-transit or re-export flows where title passes abroad fall outside the source rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign-source revenue and export-oriented flows excluded by the territorial system; must be separately disclosed with supporting contracts and bills of lading.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The importer must evidence transfer of title overseas to sustain the exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Invoice cost of imported merchandise, customs duties, cold-storage handling, freight, insurance, and operating overhead; all local invoices must be registered and subject to applicable withholding.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments to non-resident suppliers for imported goods are not subject to Panamanian withholding, as goods are outside the services-withholding base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disallowed items: personal expenses of shareholders, gifts, excess interest, and 50% of certain registration or municipal taxes.
Taxable net income after cost of goods sold, deductions, and add-backs.
Final corporate income tax computed at 25% on taxable net income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; the shareholder cannot apply foreign tax credits against the S.A.'s Panamanian ISR.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly prepayments and applicable withholding credits (e.g., 3% withholding on certain service invoices) offset against the gross tax.
Disclosure of related-party transactions (e.g., purchases of frozen goods from offshore group vendors) and the arm's length method applied.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The resident importer must report all controlled cross-border transactions; the foreign related supplier must provide comparability documentation upon request.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of dividend distributions made during the fiscal year and the 10% dividend withholding tax remitted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A 10% final dividend withholding applies at distribution; DTA relief requires a valid Tax Residency Certificate in the entity's records.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing fine: USD 50 to USD 500; late payment: automatic 10% surcharge on the unpaid tax plus monthly statutory interest of 1%; false or incomplete return: fine of USD 500 to USD 5,000 plus reassessment and criminal prosecution where fraud is established.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on dividends paid by a Panamanian S.A. out of taxed profits; the 10% also applies to distributions from exempt or foreign-source profits, with no credit attaching to the corporate ISR.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a reduced treaty rate, the non-resident shareholder must deliver to the paying S.A. before distribution: (i) a Certificate of Tax Residency (TRC) issued by the home tax authority, apostilled or legalized and translated into Spanish; (ii) a signed beneficial-ownership and treaty-eligibility declaration; and (iii) a DGI reduced-withholding application where required. The S.A. must retain the TRC for five years. Panama's treaty network (Barbados, Mexico, Portugal, Qatar, Singapore, United Kingdom, among others) typically fixes dividend withholding at 5%-10% depending on shareholding thresholds.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties for trademarks, patents and industrial know-how paid to non-residents: 12.5% statutory withholding, reducible to 5%-10% under applicable DTAs. Interest paid to non-resident related lenders and financial institutions: 5% statutory withholding where the interest is sourced in Panama or secured against Panamanian assets; treaty rates commonly range from 0% to 10%.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File documentation and Form 708 disclosure are triggered when the aggregate value of related-party transactions exceeds B/.250,000 (USD 250,000) per fiscal year; a Country-by-Country Report is required for multinational groups with consolidated revenue of at least USD 750 million.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama maintains Economic Substance Rules (ESR) for entities conducting relevant activities, which expressly include distribution and import/export of goods. The frozen-beef and seafood importer must demonstrate Panamanian management (board meetings in Panama), physical premises (cold-chain warehousing), adequate employees, and expenditure proportionate to the volume of trade, and must file the annual substance declaration with the DGI. Territorial tax exemption does not remove the substance obligation; failure exposes the entity to administrative fines and RUC cancellation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsifying import invoices, under-declaring cold-chain sales volume, fabricating cold-storage expenses, or routing Panamanian sales proceeds through offshore accounts to eliminate the 25% ISR base.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment of the evaded tax plus 10% surcharge and 1% monthly interest; administrative fine of 50%-150% of the evaded amount; criminal conviction carries imprisonment of 2 to 6 years under the Criminal Tax provisions of the Codigo Fiscal.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Signing officers and directors are jointly and severally liable for the corporate tax debt where they directed the falsification; criminal conviction triggers impedimento de salida (travel ban), disqualification from management, and seizure of personal assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a nominee S.A. with no local directors, employees, premises or trade management while booking large frozen-commodity volumes and claiming territorial exemptions on foreign-source flows.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to B/.50,000, RUC cancellation, compulsory dissolution, and re-attribution of income to the ultimate beneficial owner with recomputed 25% ISR and 10% dividend withholding; adverse EU/OECD listings may follow.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors face personal fines and regulatory disqualification; failure to file UBO declarations triggers separate AML penalties and criminal exposure for fronting.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Over-invoicing or under-invoicing beef and seafood consignments, duplicating bills of lading, mischaracterizing financing proceeds as trade payments, or laundering through Panama's dollarized banking system with revolving letters of credit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Decree-Law 31 of 2015: freezing and confiscation of assets, fines up to B/.5 million, and imprisonment of 5 to 10 years; the bank relationship is terminated and the entity is blacklisted by the UAF.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, signatories and compliance officers are personally prosecutable; courts routinely impose travel bans, personal asset seizure, and 5-10 year custodial sentences for structured trade transactions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Remitting profits to the foreign shareholder disguised as director loan repayments, reinvoicing commissions, or capital reimbursement while circumventing the 10% dividend withholding and the treaty TRC procedure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The S.A., as withholding agent, is assessed the full 10% un-withheld tax plus 10% surcharge and 1% monthly interest; fines of B/.50 to B/.500 per omitted declaration apply.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers who instructed the disguised distribution are personally liable for the un-withheld tax and may face criminal prosecution for breach of withholding-agent duties.
